# FlipLens

> FlipLens (https://fliplens.eu) is a web app for resellers in Europe that answers "I can buy this for €X: is it worth buying to resell?". From a photo, a barcode or a typed model it identifies the exact product, reads comparable active eBay listings in Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the Netherlands (in euro) or on eBay.co.uk (in pounds), estimates the resale value, subtracts marketplace fees and shipping, and returns profit, ROI, the maximum price worth paying and a verdict (strong buy, buy, borderline, skip). It is independent, not affiliated with eBay, and does not buy, sell or ship items.

Key facts:
- Works best for consumer electronics, gaming and cameras (headphones, phones, tablets, laptops, consoles, controllers, games, camera bodies, lenses) and power tools. Branded clothes, shoes and bags are priced too, by brand, type and condition (a rougher estimate than for electronics). LEGO sets by set number; books, vinyl, CDs and DVDs by barcode. Watches by model; branded jewellery by brand and type (unbranded gold and silver, furniture and vehicles are not priced).
- The purchase price is optional: without it FlipLens shows the maximum price worth paying for the user's target ROI.
- Fee profiles: eBay.de private and business sellers, eBay.it and eBay.fr private sellers, eBay.co.uk private sellers, Vinted, local pickup. Each shows when it was last checked.
- Table scan: one photo of a stall, box or shelf finds up to 6 items and checks each against eBay listings, best buys first. Live radar: with the camera open, items get boxes with their names as the phone moves; a tap runs a real check before any price is shown. Both for Google sign-in accounts, Free included.
- Users selling on eBay.co.uk (the default for the United Kingdom, selectable from any country) get eBay.co.uk data and prices in pounds; eBay.de sellers get the five EU sites in euro. A UK vs EU comparison on the result shows the checked item on eBay.co.uk and on the five EU sites side by side, in pounds and euros, without using a check.
- When fewer than 5 comparable listings remain it says "not enough market data" instead of guessing.
- Pricing (EUR, final prices): Free at €0: 10 checks per month; Pro at €9.99/month: 100 checks per month; Reseller at €19.99/month: unlimited checks, fair use 1,000/month.
- Also: a listing writer that turns a photo of any item (clothes included) into a Vinted, eBay or Kleinanzeigen title and description (3 free per month), and stock tracking with real profit.
- Installs on phones as a web app (PWA). Sign-in with Google. Photos are never stored.
- Available in English, German, Italian and French (the app follows the browser language; German pages under https://fliplens.eu/de, Italian under https://fliplens.eu/it, French under https://fliplens.eu/fr).
- Operator: Evgenii Stepanishin, Slovenia. Contact: support@fliplens.eu.

## Guides
- [How to check an item's resale value before you buy it](https://fliplens.eu/guides/how-to-check-resale-value): A step-by-step method to find what a second-hand item really resells for in Europe, subtract fees and shipping, and work out the maximum price worth paying.
- [eBay.de fees in 2026: private vs business sellers](https://fliplens.eu/guides/ebay-fees-germany): What selling on eBay Germany costs private and business sellers, with an example of how fees change your profit and the price you can pay for stock.
- [Where to sell used electronics in Europe](https://fliplens.eu/guides/where-to-sell-used-electronics-europe): Compare eBay, Vinted, Kleinanzeigen and local cash sales for second-hand electronics in Europe: who pays fees, reach, speed and when each one makes sense.
- [Flea market reselling checklist](https://fliplens.eu/guides/flea-market-reselling-checklist): A practical checklist for buying second-hand electronics, consoles and cameras at flea markets and car boot sales to resell: identification, testing, completeness, locks and price.
- [How to sell on Vinted](https://fliplens.eu/guides/how-to-sell-on-vinted): A practical guide to selling on Vinted in Europe: who pays the fees, how to photograph and describe items, how to price them and how to ship.
- [How much is my console worth?](https://fliplens.eu/guides/how-much-is-my-console-worth): What decides the resale value of a used console, handheld, controller or game in Europe, the mistakes that cost money, and how to check the price in seconds.
- [Resale value of used cameras and lenses](https://fliplens.eu/guides/resale-value-cameras-lenses): What decides the resale value of a used camera body or lens in Europe: mount, shutter count, sensor and glass condition, completeness and region, plus a quick checklist.
- [Resale value of used headphones and earbuds](https://fliplens.eu/guides/resale-value-headphones): What decides the resale value of used headphones and earbuds in Europe: exact generation, battery wear, ear pads, completeness and hygiene, plus a quick checklist.
- [Selling a used phone in Europe](https://fliplens.eu/guides/sell-used-phone-europe): What decides the resale value of a used smartphone in Europe: model, storage, battery health, account and carrier locks, condition, plus a checklist before you buy or sell.
- [How much are my clothes worth?](https://fliplens.eu/guides/resale-value-branded-clothes): What decides the resale value of used jackets, jeans, dresses, hoodies and bags: brand, condition, size, season and completeness, and where to sell them.
- [Sneaker resale value: how much are my trainers worth?](https://fliplens.eu/guides/sneaker-resale-value): What decides the resale value of used sneakers: model, size, condition, the original box and authenticity, plus where to sell them in Europe and the UK.
- [How much is my LEGO set worth?](https://fliplens.eu/guides/lego-set-value): What decides the resale value of a used LEGO set: the set number, condition, completeness, minifigures and whether it is retired, plus where to sell it.
- [Resale value of books, vinyl records, CDs and DVDs](https://fliplens.eu/guides/resale-value-books-vinyl-dvds): How to find what your used books, vinyl records, CDs and DVDs are worth: barcode, edition and format, buyback services versus selling yourself.
